posts.author: wib030
posts.body:
Hi there, I wanted to ask if it is possible to change the value for Buffs and Debuffs in RPG Maker MZ.
For example, currently 1 stat buff is 25% and 2 is 50%, would I be able to make these numbers higher?
I have the VisuStella Battle core but I could not find any way to edit the exact values through it.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum! So it's states you want to check.
Go to your data base, States tab, then you should have a list of states.
On the right of your window you should see traits? This is what you want the state to do.
Click on any empty space there and it should bring up another window.
A smaller window with tabs,
Rate, Param, attack, skill, equip, other.
Click on the Param to adjust the parameters the state will affect.
Hp, MP, ATK, Def, etc.
How the formula works is 110% is 10% more and 80% is 20% less.
Choose which parameter you want to adjust.
